subject: Inside Payhawk’s $280m raise
notes: The issue also reports a $4.7m raise by 'the other Staniszewski brother' with Paul Graham as a backer, but does not name the company in the visible text, so no entry was written for it. stories.headline: Payhawk raised $280m; Sifted interview on how it did so amid a fintech downturn
stories.quote: Interview: How Payhawk raised $280m amid fintech downturn.

stories.headline: Dcubed raised €27.2m Series A led by Warsaw Equity Group
stories.quote: Munich, Germany-based Dcubed, which develops and manufactures deployment and power systems for satellites and other space applications, raised €27.2m in Series A funding. Warsaw Equity Group led the round
stories.description: Develops and manufactures deployment and power systems for satellites

stories.headline: Blackbird Coffee raised €16m Series A led by HenQ
stories.quote: Copenhagen-based Blackbird Coffee, which provides coffee to workplaces through connected machines and its own software, raised €16m in Series A funding. HenQ led the round and was joined by Seed Capital and Damgaard Company.
stories.description: Provides coffee to workplaces through connected machines and its own software

stories.headline: Iconic raised €9.1m seed led by Peak Capital
stories.quote: Amsterdam-based Iconic, an AI operating system to manage and optimise large capital projects, raised €9.1m in seed funding. Peak Capital led the round and was joined by investors including Bridford Group, Common Magic, and Graduate Ventures.
stories.description: AI operating system to manage and optimise large capital projects

stories.headline: MountAIn raised €7.3m seed led by 360 Capital and Supernova Invest
stories.quote: Meylan, France-based MountAIn, which develops affordable AI infrastructure solutions designed to run advanced models on low-cost chips, raised €7.3m in seed funding. 360 Capital and Supernova Invest led the round
stories.description: Affordable AI infrastructure to run advanced models on low-cost chips

stories.headline: CEOs of European startups including ElevenLabs and Lovable call on the EU to raise AI investment and cut red tape
stories.quote: The CEOs of some of Europe's leading startups — including ElevenLabs and Lovable — called on the EU to dramatically increase investment in AI and slash red tape.

stories.headline: Schneider Electric Ventures is bringing its accelerator scheme to Europe
stories.quote: Exclusive: Schneider Electric Ventures is bringing its accelerator scheme to Europe.
